notes.title: Wild Russia is no longer wild
notes.notes:
So there was a big update for the little-known horror Wild Russia, which appeared on Steam on April 28.

[list]
[*] [b]Updated barriers. [/b]
Thanks to new visual cues, finding out how much is left to activate leverage is easy.

[*] [b]Updated leverage. [/b]
You will now hear distinguished sounds of lever activation and deactivation.

[*] [b]Updated snow. [/b]
Snowflakes will not fall through the roof and you can hide from the snow indoors.

[*] [b]Achievement. [/b]
Now you will not receive the most difficult achievement "Lost in Russia" instantly. Will have to "try" to execute it.

[*] [b]Advanced settings. [/b]
Now you can limit the number of frames per second by setting an arbitrary number in the settings. Vertical sync has also been added.

[*] [b]Convenient return. [/b]
Now it is not necessary to press the “Continue” button to return to the game during a pause, you can do this by pressing the “Esc” button.

[*] [b]Easter egg. [/b]
Easter egg.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/259bf0d32927d1b15d8de5140e30fc4906c0642d.jpg[/img]


[h2]About music[/h2]
We would not have to write about this without having received so many questions related to music in the horror Wild Russia.
As soon as the game came out, it used a remix of one popular song by a British band. This caused some problems.
In the first update, this track was replaced with a cover version of "Zero" (gr. Coffee) from a Russian artist, who is in the game to this day. This saved the creators of video content with the game Wild Russia from "strikes" in the AP. Therefore, do not worry about videos or broadcasts.
Actually, that’s all you needed to know on this topic.


[h2]About unreasonably high prices[/h2]
In the CIS countries, as well as in some European countries, the price for the Wild Russia project is much higher than in Russia. This is because for all other countries except Russia, prices were set automatically based on a single price for the United States at $ 19.99. As it turned out, the price difference was more than significant, but they did not change it. This is due to the Steam rules, which prohibit the provision of discounts for 30 days after the price change, which is not desirable for the Wild Russia project, since it participates in a seasonal sale with a 75% discount, which will be held on Steam in the summer.
Upon completion of the sale, perhaps the price will be adjusted for some countries.


[h2]Future projects[/h2]
At the moment, an unannounced project under the temporary name Utopia Project in the adventure genre is under development. You can find out the first news on the project on our website [url=http://andreev.world]Andreev.world[/url], as well as in communities in the social networks.

notes.title: Wild Update!
notes.notes:
Today, April 30, 2020, the long-awaited update of the Wild Russia horror was released.
No one was waiting, but it came out!

What is updated in the game?
[list]
[*] Increased game difficulty! Enemies became more aggressive, Agent Red got serious problems in Wild Russia! You can’t sit out indoors, the wild enemy will block you, blocking all the escape routes, and this will end your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/0e1909876bc88d1fe6648218440d4541cc900a5a.jpg[/img]

[*] Flashlight is the player’s best friend! Now it is safe for the eyes, and does not blind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/767062945df092eff611c85ac7cd8058490398d2.jpg[/img]

[*] The Achievement Achievement justifies itself now. You will be warned that you have survived (before that you could only guess about it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/3e6285cb95e25630e16f9350d519b1e6d1b63088.jpg[/img]

[*] No, this is not a mistake, and the key is not stuck. This is a new wild feature - auto run, with Red you can turn on the "cruise" control, where you just have to steer it in the right direction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/0281530cc2addb84f654ae6341c2358d4fc6fb60.jpg[/img]

[*] Where are the enemies going? After you. They thawed, and completely run wild. It seems that there are more of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/439b5edfde575fe07c24fc5f8a6ef835aa6c0b69.jpg[/img]

[*] Don't keep up with Red? Everything is fine. We twisted his speed a bit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/e5ba54e056b031dc861c8002be09010bad7e813d.jpg[/img]

[*] Now you have a chance to survive. Health will gradually recover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/73d97b1beb4deee0030bce2ecb8d22a7a8592235.jpg[/img]

[*] Did not find out what is required of you? Now, when you start a new game, they will write to you what to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/cd64618b6b7785e257f79034f3ccfa9c638082d3.jpg[/img]

[*] Did you like to "stomp on the parquet" while walking in the winter forest? Now do not sink. But you can "creak" on freshly fallen snow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/b91c68f2c80361fd31e14f4c24e85c4cda16d188.jpg[/img]

[*] Hardcore is over. Now for casuals, we highlighted places with levers to make them easier to find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/6d26ab2a681b1246b29d512e02530912d52382be.jpg[/img]

[*] Captions. Дикая Россия Wild Russia.
[/list]

Expect the next update soon, in which some game mechanics will be changed and new wild features will be added.

And now, you can re-run the game again, evaluate the update, and write to us what you think about it, and we, in turn, will answer what we think.

notes.title: Breaking News
notes.notes:
This week we opened access to the project [b]Wild Russia[/b] for the press. And at the moment we have received enough feedback on the game to make a list of the most important changes that will be released in the first patch. But we do not stop there and further expect more information from you about errors and unpleasant moments of the game.

I would like to note that there are few complaints from the technical side, suggestions from those who played mainly related to changes in some game moments in order to simplify gameplay and add new features to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/c413e1bc7a6398518513147f25a27882af7ac428.png[/img]

Today (April 26), there are already those who completed the game without using a developer card! We did not expect that it will be held at all, so we are very happy =)

We remind you that you can send feedback on the game both to [url=https://andreev.world/#contacts]mail[/url], and to discussions on Steam. We will try to answer everyone!

[i]Good luck in Wild Russia! Do not be ill! ;D[/i]

notes.title: Wild Russia comes out in a week!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/a179a3b121bf7548f69007ed7a62bc6b070359a5.jpg[/img]

We are glad to inform you about the imminent release of the Wild Russia project on Steam! This will happen on April 28 this year.
Recall that this is an adventure game in the horror genre, which takes place in provincial Russia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392204/0d1d14ea7a7b717620e39122184ac78634fd9f1f.png[/img]

[b]"Wild Russia"[/b] is an open-world horror adventure game. Its action takes place in a striking provincial Russia, and any of your actions or inaction can lead to serious consequences. You play as a brave agent Red from Russia, who is entrusted with finding a way out in a vast world full of dangers, anomalies, dark gates and abandoned buildings.
